scope: This review covers only the authorized retry2 R=0 control raw. No other run outcome was analyzed. Raw files were read-only. No SUMO, TraCI, netconvert, or classifier-threshold changes.

input_and_lifecycle.explicit_zero_evidence: FINAL exact card binds R=0/U=0/X=0; exact materialized demand contains only 1333 M_flow identities and no R/U/X or flow identities; tripinfo/vehroute/FCD contain no R/U/X identity.

lane_changes.locked_analyzer_lane_mapping_integrity: PASS; no unknown M lane, auxiliary-lane, or out-of-domain sample flags

measurement_and_alternative_checks.downstream_and_source: All 1333 M inserted within demand window; maximum recorded insertion/departure delay 0.875 s; all completed and passed the two downstream E1 detectors; last M FCD sample by 1576 s. This does not show a downstream receiving-space failure.
measurement_and_alternative_checks.queue_export_limitation: queues.xml has complete 0..2699 labels but empty <lanes/> at each label; it provides no queue occupancy series and is not treated as evidence of no queues. Full vehicle completion, downstream E1 passage, FCD, and E2 coverage provide the remaining checks.

locked_classification.all_L_rows_are: SHORT_LOW_STATE_CANDIDATE, one 30-s low bin per row; none met locked two-bin L duration
locked_classification.reference_screen: FAIL: 160/180 rows failed; strict high-mobility/reference screen is not the R=0 eligibility criterion in the approved minimal plan, and is not relabeled PASS. It documents retained low-speed-ratio background.
locked_classification.candidate_C_adjudication: Warnings are retained. Each cell episode is one 30-s bin, with no within-cell consecutive two-bin episode. Several same-bin multi-cell patches occur, including around 720, 990, 1170 and 1380 s; they do not meet locked P/S/L sustained criteria. Some recovery fields are unresolved because reference/coverage conditions are not met; those are not treated as recovered or erased.

compatibility_and_provenance_note: The unchanged locked analyzer source/hash and P/S/L thresholds were used. In-memory data-format binding handled R02 output-folder/run_id convention, materialized M <vehicle> identities with exact desired-depart schedule instead of an aggregate M flow, and unioned an added exporter field recovery_start_s. These adaptations changed only input-schema binding/output column serialization; they did not change classifier calculations or thresholds. The adapter application_receipt records the source adapter file hash; these wrapper adaptations are disclosed here and should be preserved in any reuse.
interpretation_boundary: Data evidence supports the minimal-plan R=0 control eligibility criteria: adequate M exposure and complete lifecycle/measurement, no locked sustained P/S/L event, no identified source/insertion or downstream failure. It does not certify a clean high-mobility baseline. The one-bin Candidate C background patches and empty queue-export lane series remain explicit scientific-review notes. The plan does not define the older label LOW_R_BACKGROUND_ACCEPTABLE; no such label is assigned here. No treatment, matched causal contrast, or Stage 6 witness conclusion can be made from this control alone.
